contract.purpose: Help coding agents compare local web and native UI automation choices by measuring verified feedback rather than successful driver execution.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Agent Testing helps coding agents and Fleet maintainers compare local UI automation choices through bounded benchmarks and independent correctness verification.
contract.driftNote: No canonical Fleet catalog record existed before this public surface; the record and Cloudflare ownership are added in the same task.
contract.audience: Coding agents and Fleet maintainers with access to the private runner repository.
contract.job: Expose the exact clone, smoke, adapter, verification, and adoption path before secondary benchmark explanation.
contract.thesis: A field manual, not a marketing landing page: linear, quiet, and executable in source order.
contract.system: Warm paper surfaces, near-black editorial headings, orange route markers, monospace commands, one reading column, and ordinary semantic links.
contract.signature: A numbered clone-to-adopt route whose commands form the page's primary information architecture.
contract.risk: The large serif title can dominate a narrow viewport; responsive sizing and a short agent-first eyebrow keep the first command path visible without horizontal overflow.

findings: Impeccable was unavailable; manual responsive, contrast, focus, overflow, and source-order review was used.

answers.product: A map and runner for local web and native UI-agent benchmarks.
answers.audience: Coding agents and maintainers with repository access.
answers.value: Faster feedback that is independently verified as correct.
answers.mechanism: Strict manifests run bounded workflows and separate product oracles before summarizing speed, cost, and reliability.
answers.proof: The page names the current Vaultwealth screening decisions and three dated measured results with limitations.
answers.nextAction: Clone the private repository, run its smoke fixture, then add one product adapter.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner delegated the choice with 'anything simple would do'; Field Manual was selected as the simplest agent-first direction.
